repairs.quote: Passive: The last champion Xin Zhao damaged with an Attack or Audacious Charge is Challenged for 3 seconds. Active: Xin Zhao unleashes a sweep around him that deals (75/175/275 + (100% bonus Attack Damage) + (110% Ability Power)) plus 15% current Health physical damage and Knocks Back all non-Challenged enemies. Afterwards, Xin Zhao becomes immune to damage from enemies outside the sweep range for 4 seconds. Deals a max of 600 damage to jungle monsters and minions.
